NEW ZEALAND SELF-EMPLOYED TAX SET-ASIDE · RUNS IN YOUR BROWSER · NOTHING UPLOADED

How much of what you earn should you set aside for tax?

Enter your business income and expenses. You get income tax, ACC earners' levy, an optional student loan repayment, and the share of every invoice to put away.

Written from the published IRD and ACC rates for the 2025-26 tax year (to 31 March 2026) without a live lookup. IRD decides. Not tax advice.

Enter your income, then click Calculate.

What it does, and what it leaves to you

    
    
      
  • Covers: resident income tax brackets, the ACC earners' levy up to the maximum liable earnings, an optional student loan repayment at 12% above the threshold, and flags for provisional tax and GST registration.
    • 
      
  • Not decided: ACC CoverPlus work levies, other income, tax credits, losses carried forward, deductions such as home-office and vehicle claims, GST amounts, non-residents, and exactly when provisional tax applies to you. IRD or your accountant decide these.
    • 
    

  


  

    
Common questions

    
How much of my sole trader income should I set aside for tax in Australia?

    
Often 20% to 30% of profit once you add income tax and the ACC earners' levy, but it depends on your profit. Enter your income and expenses here for a number built from the actual rates.

    
Do I pay ACC as self-employed?

    
Yes. Self-employed people pay the ACC earners' levy on profit, collected through your tax return, plus a CoverPlus work levy billed by ACC. KiwiSaver contributions for yourself are voluntary.

    
Do I pay tax in instalments?

    
If your residual income tax is above $5,000 you become a provisional taxpayer. With a 31 March balance date the standard-option instalments are due 28 August, 15 January and 7 May.

    
When must I register for GST?

    
When your turnover reaches $60,000 in the last 12 months or is expected to in the next 12. GST you collect belongs to IRD, so keep it out of your set-aside.

    
Is my data uploaded anywhere?

    
No. Everything is calculated in your browser and nothing is sent.

Your answers. This page runs in your browser and sends nothing anywhere; closing the tab discards them, and downloads are files on your own device.

    
Best-effort hosting, no SLA. These tools are free, experimental, and may be slow, broken, moved, or taken offline without notice. We do not promise uptime, backups of anything you type, or that a URL will keep working. Do not use this as a system of record: nothing you enter is saved anywhere.

    
Everything runs in your browser. Your answers are never uploaded; there are no accounts, cookies, or analytics vendors. Anonymous feature events (analysis_run, example_loaded, summary_downloaded) are counted only in local storage on your device, never with any of your data, and are switched off by Do Not Track.
